title: Toyota Supra 3D Model (Free)
author: Mpgs Studios
publisherDescription: Publisher identifies this as a Supra modeled in Blender. The public listing, glTF asset.extras, and accompanying license.txt identify the same creator and CC BY license.
usage: Ordinary deterministic mesh conversion and game rendering. No AI training, datasets, or generative asset creation uses this model.
vehicleRepresentation: Community Toyota GR Supra A90 exterior used for the simulated 3.0T RZ. Exact model year and trim-specific exterior accuracy are not manufacturer-certified.

visualReferences.subject: Official GR Supra rear photograph: dark lamp housings and red light guides, circular exhaust tips, plate recess, diffuser and central reverse-light lens array.
visualReferences.usage: Visually inspected reference only; photograph is not shipped in the runtime or repository.

visualReferences.subject: 17 May 2019 Japan Supra launch exterior gallery.

download.method: Public GitHub raw files retaining original source and CC BY attribution; no Sketchfab account or viewer extraction used.

sourceGeometry.provenanceCheck: Node names contain a ToyotaSupera2021 OBJ scene and ordinary body/tire/glass/light materials. No third-party game names or extraction statement was found in the inspected metadata and publisher description. This is not a forensic originality guarantee.

changes: Welded redundant vertices and simplified surface geometry with meshoptimizer.
Kept paint-surface vertex normals in the simplification error metric to preserve smooth highlights.
Merged surfaces sharing appearance to reduce draw calls.
Converted source forward -Z / up +Y to forward +X / right +Y / up +Z with a proper rotation.
Scaled the source uniformly to 4.38 metres length and placed tires on ground zero.
Adapted paint, glass, chrome and light materials to the race renderer.
Separated lamp-cover triangles from the shared window material so tail lamps remain visible.
Corrected rear-lamp materials against Toyota's rear photograph: dark red housing and red LED light guides instead of a solid red housing with white guides.
Assigned only the rear diffuser a fixed dark-charcoal reflective finish so its moulded curves remain visible; tires retain the nonreflective rubber material.
Preserved additional rear bumper, ducktail, diffuser, emblem and chrome exhaust geometry for the close rear camera.

The main rear bumper keeps all 52,736 source triangles. Its angular central recess shoulders remain a source-model limitation; increasing its triangle retention did not materially change those surfaces in visual comparison.

Added an authored display plate and bevelled frame inside the existing plate recess, plus a dark central reverse-lamp housing with 20 unlit dot lenses; these are photo-informed additions, not manufacturer CAD. The display plate is not a real registration.
Created a separate low-detail software-renderer mesh; hidden cabin details and original line primitives are omitted.

excludedCandidate.author: thelightning
excludedCandidate.decision: Not used. Inspected mesh names refer to another model-sharing source and a title matching an earlier commercial model; the redistribution chain could not be resolved. This does not establish that the publisher infringed copyright.
